name: parsinegar.app
description: Parsinegar application plugin: owns the route catalog of version 1 and the app-wide data reset

provides.name: parsinegar.app.service
provides.description: App-level operations that span every plugin's stores.

methods.name: wipeAllData
methods.description: Wipes every declared collection (documents, folders, settings, disk drafts, sync backend and state) in one atomic cross-collection transaction. Returns per-collection counts as they were before the wipe; publishes no event — the caller reloads the page right after.
